title: The Overview Effect
caption: Astronauts who see Earth from space often describe a lasting shift: borders vanish and humanity feels like one fragile family.

title: Why You Keep Scrolling
caption: Unpredictable rewards are the most habit-forming. B.F. Skinner showed it with pigeons; every refresh of a feed works the same way.

title: Pay Yourself First
caption: Automate saving on payday. Money moved before you see it doesn't get spent, so saving stops relying on willpower.

title: The Rule of 72
caption: Divide 72 by a yearly rate to see how long money takes to double. At 3% inflation, prices double in about 24 years.

title: The Plaque Left on the Moon
caption: Apollo 11's lunar module left a plaque on the Moon in 1969. Its last line: "We came in peace for all mankind."

title: The Shuttle's Last Ride
caption: On July 21, 2011, Atlantis landed in Florida, ending NASA's Space Shuttle program after 30 years and 135 missions.

title: Fire Without Gravity
caption: On Earth, hot air rises and stretches flames upward. In microgravity there's no rising air, so flames turn round, dim and slow.

title: Why Water Floats as a Ball
caption: In orbit, surface tension is the strongest force on loose water, so it pulls itself into a wobbly sphere that bends light like a lens.

title: You See the Sun's Past
caption: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth, so when we spot a solar flare, it actually happened 8 minutes earlier.

title: The Moon Is Leaving
caption: The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm farther from Earth every year, roughly as fast as your fingernails grow. Lasers bounced off it prove it.

title: Screens vs. Sleep
caption: Bright screen light at night can delay melatonin, the hormone that makes you sleepy. Put the phone away before bed to fall asleep faster.

title: The After-Meal Walk
caption: Even 2 to 5 minutes of light walking after eating helps blunt blood sugar spikes, a 2022 review found. No gym required.

title: The Two-Minute Rule
caption: If a task takes under two minutes, do it now. Tracking it later costs more than finishing it. (David Allen, Getting Things Done)

title: The Pomodoro Technique
caption: Work 25 minutes, break 5. Francesco Cirillo invented it in the late 1980s using a tomato-shaped kitchen timer.

title: The Helicopter That Overachieved
caption: NASA's Ingenuity was built for up to 5 test flights on Mars. It flew 72 times, in air about 1% as dense as Earth's.

title: Robots That Fly on Fans
caption: NASA's Astrobee robots drift around the space station and steer by pushing air with electric fans. No wings or thrusters needed.
